items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: Well a cousin of mine was playing for his first trumpet, Leo Dejon, Harold Dejon's brother.

ctx.x: Well, who was in that? You never heard about that?

I don't think so. Well a cousin of mine was playing for his first trumpet, Leo Dejon, Harold Dejon's brother. He's got a brother out there in the west coast now. And there was another fellow by the name of Joe Phillips, he played trumpet. He plays in the bass. Yeah, incidentally he was one of Chalini's pupils, one of Chalini's dark pupils. And there was another fellow by the name of Sidney Montague, he played drums.
I've heard of him, I don't know him.
